property_summary: After sending 1 wei to the contract (via fallback) and calling sendMoney(address(this), 0, "") from a non-owner, the reference reverts (onlyOwner checks) while the buggy version succeeds, making the contract balance zero in the buggy version versus non-zero in the reference.
change_summary: Change the modifier to always pass (remove the require) so that anyone can call sendMoney without being owner, enabling direct withdrawal of contract funds.
